notes.title: Localization update!
notes.content:
Hi Folks,

Thank you for playing No Numbers!

New languages added!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44627061/c87ff32d6a95ac1b5362ea780aaafaf1d5fa5ef8.png

This update adds support for more languages: Thai, Finnish, Ukrainian, Greek, Italian & Brazilian Portuguese.

Fullscreen option added!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44627061/7fd81eb2283be43da0a03398550f95d152e3234c.png

I've also added a fullscreen option and fixed some UI alignment issues for longer strings.

If you come across any issues with the game let me know so I can fix it for you!


Happy puzzling!

notes.title: Quality of Life Update #1
notes.content:
Hey Folks!

Thank you for playing No Numbers!

The first update is going live today and it contains several quality of life improvements:

Undo Button
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44627061/ecf36539b426455b3c8f3e3d648c25e4dbf358f8.png
You can now undo your moves, allowing for quick corrections instead of having to replay all steps.


Volume Sliders
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44627061/4d41d38311f6a952e9e0d8ac75f89e6783fc35c0.png

You can now change the volume of both sound effects and the soundtrack so you can get the audio mix you prefer.



If you have any suggestions for further improvements, please reach out via the support email, community posts or mention it in the reviews! 

Happy puzzling!
